name: rosetta-sum-and-product-puzzle
code:
use default

use Pair = (x: int, y: int)

sum(pair: Pair) -> int => pair.x + pair.y
product(pair: Pair) -> int => pair.x * pair.y

let candidates =
    (2::100)
        |> flat_map(x => (x + 1::100 - x) |> map(y => (x = x, y = y)))
        |> collect_list()

with_sum(pairs: List[Pair], value: int) -> List[Pair] =>
    pairs |> filter(p => sum(p) == value) |> collect_list()

with_product(pairs: List[Pair], value: int) -> List[Pair] =>
    pairs |> filter(p => product(p) == value) |> collect_list()

let s_knows_p_does_not =
    candidates
        |> filter(pair =>
            with_sum(candidates, sum(pair))
                |> all(q => with_product(candidates, product(q)).count > 1))
        |> collect_list()

let p_now_knows =
    s_knows_p_does_not
        |> filter(pair =>
            with_product(s_knows_p_does_not, product(pair)).count == 1)
        |> collect_list()

let s_now_knows =
    p_now_knows
        |> filter(pair => with_sum(p_now_knows, sum(pair)).count == 1)

for (x, y) in s_now_knows do
    write_line("X = {x}, Y = {y}")
od
